snippet.title: The most beautiful part of humanity lives in hearts that turn compassion into action. ❤️
snippet.description:
Every time we choose compassion over indifference, we bring our world a little closer to the one we wish to live in. 🤍🐾

In West Azerbaijan Province, Iran, a dog found herself in a frightening situation after becoming trapped in a water canal. The steep, sloping concrete walls made it nearly impossible for her to climb out, and despite her efforts, she remained helplessly stranded in the water.

Just imagine how exhausting and terrifying this must have been. The dog was surrounded by water, struggling to find a way to safety, with no way of knowing whether anyone would notice her before her strength ran out. 💔

But thankfully, kind hearts noticed. ❤️

When several people spotted the struggling dog, they immediately rushed toward the canal. There was no time to wait for special equipment, so they began looking for a way to help using whatever they had available.

And what happened next was a beautiful example of compassion and teamwork.

Using a piece of fabric, the rescuers worked together to form a human chain along the steep canal bank. While some held on to support one another, another person reached down toward the frightened dog, determined to bring her out of danger.

Together, they managed to pull her to safety. 🥹❤️

What touches me most about this rescue is how quickly these people turned concern into action. They could have stood there watching, hoping someone else would come along. But instead, they chose to become the help this precious animal desperately needed.

They didn’t need to know who the dog belonged to. They didn’t need a reward or recognition. They simply understood that another life was in danger, and that was reason enough to do something.

This is exactly what Tata Harmony Way is about — ordinary people with extraordinary hearts who remind us that a kinder world isn’t something we simply wish for. It’s something we create through the choices we make.

My heartfelt admiration and gratitude go to these wonderful rescuers for working together to save a helpless dog. And a special thank you to @ali__abdinejad for sharing this beautiful act of humanity with the world. ❤️

snippet.title: Nine killed after jet crashes near West Palm Beach airport
snippet.description:
Nine people died after a Bahamas-bound Learjet crashed and then erupted in a fireball in Palm Beach County, Florida, Sunday afternoon, officials said.

The crash is the second deadliest in the United States this year, according to NTSB records, following June’s skydiving plane crash in Butler, Missouri, which killed 12. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy called the crash a “horrific tragedy.”

The plane was a Learjet 60 flying to the Bahamas from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport, according to the Federal Aviation Administration. It is registered to an LLC in Delaware, according to FAA records, and is listed as available for charter online.

    우크라이나 국방부 산하 정보총국(GUR)은 텔레그램을 통해 "러시아 아흐투빈스크 군용 비행장에서 시동 과정 중 폭발한 러시아의 Su-57 1대당 가격은 약 1억5천만 달러(한화 약 2천억원)로 추산된다"면서 품질이 낮거나 불순물이 섞인 항공유 사용을 폭발 원인으로 지목했습니다. 
    최근 우크라이나의 지속적인 러시아 정유시설 타격으로 항공유 공급망에 문제가 생긴 것이라는 분석도 나오고 있는데요. 영상으로 보시죠.

snippet.title: 「トラックが横転している」中型トラックが単独で横転　50代男性運転手が軽傷　阪神高速環状線・本町出口付近　大阪・中央区｜TBS NEWS DIG
snippet.description:
きょう午前、大阪の阪神高速環状線でトラックが横転する事故があり、運転手が軽傷です。

きょう午前9時45分ごろ、大阪市中央区の阪神高速環状線・本町出口付近で、「トラックが横転している」と通りかかった車から警察に通報がありました。

警察や消防などによりますと、中型トラックが単独で横転し、50代の男性運転手が病院に運ばれましたが、軽傷だということです。

現場は大阪市内の中心部を走る交通量の多い場所で、現場では4車線のうち3車線の通行が規制されました。

警察は運転手から事情を聴くなどして、事故の原因を調べています。
